*Develop a feature locally from a reviewed plan through tests, commits, and a draft pull request.*

> **Keep planning, review, implementation and testing local until the final push and draft pull request.**

## Why install this

Issueflow coordinates work through GitHub checkpoints and review rounds. Local-dev
keeps the development conversation in the terminal: choose an issue or type a
feature, clarify the requirements, red-team a plan, commit it, implement, test,
and commit the result. GitHub is used for optional issue intake and the final draft PR.

The agent does the work directly. There is no daemon, stage-registration API,
remote claim, review-comment loop or CI polling. The plan and Git history let an
interrupted session resume where it stopped.

## What you get

| Path | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `skills/local-dev/SKILL.md` | What the agent reads: triggers, the flow, and the one rule. |
| `skills/local-dev/scripts/` | The deterministic half — `inspect`, `issues`, `issue`, `report`. |
| `skills/local-dev/references/plan-template.md` | The minimal local plan and review artifacts. |
| `skills/local-dev/references/delivery.md` | One final publication phase and recovery from uncertain outcomes. |
| `skills/local-dev/skill-invariants.json` | The prose guardrails and the baseline eval declaration. |

## Quick start

Claude Code — run in chat:

```text
/plugin marketplace add natejswenson/claude-skills
/plugin install local-dev@claude-skills
/local-dev
```

Codex — run in a terminal from the root of this repository checkout:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add "$PWD"
codex plugin add local-dev@claude-skills
```

Start a new Codex session, then invoke in chat:

```text
$local-dev
```

Examples in the agent chat:

```text
/local-dev Add CSV export to the reports page
$local-dev Implement issue 42
$local-dev
```

Without a task, the selector offers **Enter your own item to work on** and
**Choose an existing GitHub issue**, plus resume when local work is present.
Clear requests go straight to investigation; questions are limited to missing
requirements. Independent plan review uses the host's native agent tool. If it
is unavailable, the skill discloses its self-review fallback.

The optional helper can also run directly from this repository's root:

```bash
node skills/local-dev/skills/local-dev/scripts/local-dev.js inspect --repo .
node skills/local-dev/skills/local-dev/scripts/local-dev.js issues --repo .
node skills/local-dev/skills/local-dev/scripts/local-dev.js issue --repo . --id 42
```

Plugin installation does not install a global `local-dev` executable. For an
installed skill, resolve its bundled script beside the loaded `SKILL.md` and
pass your working repository separately with `--repo`.

## Triggers

- "local-dev"
- "build this feature locally"
- "work on this without issueflow"

## Requirements

- **Claude Code:** Local file/shell access, Git, Node 18+, and native agent delegation for independent review. No app connection is needed for local work.
- **Codex:** The same scripts, local tools and runtimes, plus native subagents for independent review. Claude connections are not imported; no app connection is needed for local work.
- **Personal data:** No private configuration or credential store. Plans and verification notes stay in the user's checkout; delivery recovery notes stay in its Git metadata. GitHub authentication is managed by `gh`.

`gh` and GitHub access are optional until issue intake or final PR delivery.
No remote is needed to plan, implement, test or commit. An unavailable publication
step leaves local work complete and delivery pending. Request “local only” to
stop at commits. Normal completion is a draft PR; merging and releasing are separate.

See [Codex migration notes](../../docs/codex-migration.md).

## Development

```bash
cd skills/local-dev/skills/local-dev
npm test
```

Node skill. `ci / local-dev` runs the same tests plus the house lints on
every pull request, and `skillfactory verify --skill local-dev` reports which rung
of the ladder it has reached.

## Changelog

See [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md). After the reviewed version and changelog land,
explicit release dispatch creates `local-dev-v<version>`; merging alone publishes nothing.
